name: qa-api-testing
description: API testing: 8 skills (postman-collections, restassured-testing, karate-testing, tavern-testing, schemathesis-fuzzing, restler-fuzzing, api-chaos-runner, api-testing-overview) and 2 agents (api-test-tool-selector, api-test-author): the selector picks a tool from project markers + goal, the author composes it to emit one functional test per endpoint + scenario.
